title: Alpha 1.0.16_66 [Horror]
description: A horror modpack in style of alpha Minecraft
body:
**PLEASE NOTE THAT THIS MODPACK IS HUGELY IN DEVELOPMENT, AND YOU MIGHT NOTICE SOME THINGS THAT WERE NOT IN ALPHA.**
# Alpha 1.0.16_66

**Notch deleted this update back in 2010. Something got into the code. Years later, someone found the lost build and patched it back together.**

![It knows](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/71ba115194507101fb2e467115714f7a487e901a_0.webp)

## Survival

You are running a version that was never meant to exist. The world looks like old Alpha — but there are some things. Things that shouldn't be there.

Mobs are rare. Animals are few. The silence is louder than you remember.

![Don't blink](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/47e3aadb2d9d676b1a33f0d3d7aef29187be3654_0.webp)

## Features

- New farming mechanics (crops, cooking, livestock)
- Updated Nether generation (but nether doesnt work?)
- Improved fog rendering (denser, closer, heavier)
- Proximity voice chat (Pretty useful if you are lazy to type in the chat)
- New advancement toast design (cool and quirky animations)
- New world animations (Adds simple animations to doors, trapdoors, etc.)
- Alot of new blocks (lanterns, carpets, stove, etc.)
- Updated the HUD a little bit (**Raised** it)
- Sprinting & Stamina system
- Removed Herobrine
- Removed Herobrine
- Removed
-
- Removed
-
-

![He couldn't](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3f931ebd46a8d46ecd7b10e1a16bcb883e4b3e1e_0.webp)

## Before you play
- Singleplayer recommended (multiplayer works but strange things happen)
- Before you create your world, please choose Moderner beta world type - Alpha, No structures.
- Don't trust the fog.

**This is Version 1.0.16_66.**
